upsertPapers.title: Tight Bounds for Online Edge Coloring
Randomized Greedy Online Edge Coloring Succeeds for Dense and Randomly-Ordered Graphs

upsertSlices.label: Online edge coloring: arrival and degree matter
upsertSlices.task: Immediate colors, with edge arrivals, one-sided vertex arrivals, and random order kept apart.
assumptions: Hollow markers locate asymptotic palette ratios. The exact additive or ε-dependent formula appears beside each point; an anchor at 1 is not an exact Δ-coloring guarantee. Low-degree classic barriers are not inferred from high-degree theorems.
